measured_cost_aware.rule: escalate only when calibrated expected accuracy gain times frozen energy value exceeds measured incremental energy and remaining latency budget

risk_aware.rule: look up development-calibrated small-model error risk by score bin; no calibration means do not escalate

simple_threshold.rule: large model only when small embedding score falls inside the predeclared uncertainty band

tuning_budget.attempt_log: append every setting and reason before scoring

final_selection_rule: selection uses development-only data and measured resource evidence; no final K data, no reject-all selection
physical_gate: requires actual Nicla, updated firmware readback, F/H exact parity/resource/standalone checks, and G-qualified meter path

pilot.scope: development-only action/cadence and cost-fitting pilot; no physical results are implied

runtime_estimate.assumptions: planning envelope only; replace duration after G bandwidth qualification; includes no failed-run reruns
